function: CSI feedback: UE compresses eigenvector-based CSI over subcarrier groups with a Transformer; BS reconstructs and extrapolates to all subcarriers; GAN augmentation enables few-shot training (p. 3, 4).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO-OFDM, BS ULA with 32 antennas, UE ULA with 4 antennas, 1024 subcarriers, 100 MHz; indoor 60 GHz, outdoor 3.5 GHz; no RIS (p. 10).
method: Transformer compression-reconstruction network and lightweight frequency extrapolation network trained end to end with cosine-similarity loss; knowledge-driven and EGAN (Wasserstein GAN) augmentation for few-shot training (p. 5, 6, 7, 9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset: indoor scenario I3 (60 GHz, 5,000 samples) and outdoor scenario O1 (3.5 GHz, 10,000 samples), 25 paths, for training and testing (p. 10).
test_conditions: Train 50-450 (indoor) or 100-900 (outdoor) samples, validate 50 or 100, test 4,500 or 9,000, all drawn from the same scenario dataset (p. 10).
baselines: Learned: CsiNet+, bi-ImCsiNet, TransNet, SampleDL, ChannelGAN-based augmentation. Non-learned: random vector quantization and 5G NR Type I codebook (p. 11, 12).
metrics: Average generalized cosine similarity (GCS) of the dominant eigenvector over subcarriers; feedback bits; FLOPs and parameters (p. 10, 11).
complexity: Extrapolation network O(4 NT Ngrp Nc) (p. 6); Table V: IEFSF 1.40 M parameters, 23.20 M FLOPs; SampleDL 1.09 M, 583.00 M (p. 15).
openness: Uses public DeepMIMO dataset [51] (p. 10); authors release no code and give no link.
q1_support: p. 10: "dataset, i.e., DeepMIMO [51], is leveraged in the simulations" - DeepMIMO ray-tracing scenarios I3 and O1 are used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 10: "all experiments are validated with 50 samples and tested with" held-out samples of the same scenario dataset; each scenario is trained on its own few samples, and no model is tested on an unseen scenario, band or antenna setup.
q3_support: p. 12: "learning-based baselines: 1) CsiNet+ [9], 2) bi-ImCsiNet [15]" plus TransNet and SampleDL, and non-learned RVQ and 5G NR Type I codebook; p. 13: "the proposed IEFSF outperforms the baselines either" in average GCS (Figs. 8-13).
q4_support: p. 14: "has a significantly smaller time complexity than the SampleDL" - Table V (p. 15) lists parameters and FLOPs per module, IEFSF 1.40 M parameters and 23.20 M FLOPs; O(4 NT Ngrp Nc) for the extrapolation network (p. 6).
q5_support: p. 10: "In the DeepMIMO dataset, the wireless channels are" built by ray tracing; DeepMIMO is a public channel dataset [51] used for training and testing, although the authors release no code.
notes: Included, area 2: eigenvector-based CSI feedback with Transformer and frequency extrapolation, few-shot training via KDDA and EGAN augmentation (p. 3). q2 not met: each scenario is trained from scratch on few samples and tested on held-out samples of the same dataset; p. 13 claims adaptation to new scenarios but no experiment tests a model on an unseen scenario.
